ops.text: 9B. Indemnification. HDI shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless the Company and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Site or any materials or technology provided by HDI infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (b) HDI's breach of applicable law; (c) any unauthorised access to or disclosure of Confidential Information, customer data or user information caused by HDI; or (d) HDI's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. The Company shall indemnify HDI against third-party claims to the extent arising out of the Content provided by the Company or the Company's breach of applicable law. The indemnified Party shall give prompt notice of the claim, the indemnifying Party shall control the defence, and the indemnified Party shall provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense; no settlement imposing liability on the indemnified Party shall be made without its consent.

ops.text: 5.5 Ownership. As between the Parties, the Company owns all right, title and interest in and to the Content, the Marks, all customer, order and user data generated through the Site, and all designs, look and feel, materials and other work product created by or for HDI specifically for the Company under this Agreement (which HDI hereby assigns to the Company). Nothing in this Agreement assigns any Company intellectual property or Company data to HDI, and no work product shall be jointly owned.

proposal.summary: Add ownership clause: Company owns the Site deliverables and customer data, with licence-back of HDI IP

quote: The Company shall have exclusive artistic and editorial control over the Site, including, without limitation, the implementation of the Content on the Site and the design and look and feel of the Site.
rationale: The Agreement allocates control (5.2), merchant-of-record status (5.3) and a Marks licence to HDI (6.1), but never allocates ownership of the Site, the work product HDI develops for us, or the customer, order and user data generated through the Site — HDI both builds and hosts it and bears the cost, so by default it would claim the deliverables and hold our data with no licence back. We inserted a Section 5.5 confirming our ownership of Content, Marks, Site work product (assigned to us) and customer data, with HDI retaining its pre-existing platform and granting us a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to embedded HDI materials, and no joint ownership.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no limitation of liability at all, so both parties are exposed to unlimited and consequential damages. We have added our standard mutual cap (greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000) with confidentiality, indemnity, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sitting outside the cap; our payment obligations are excluded from the cap.

ops.text: 9A. Limitation of Liability. Except for Excluded Claims, (a) neither Party shall be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive damages, and (b) each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (i) the amounts paid or payable by the Company to HDI under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (ii) One Million Dollars ($1,000,000). "Excluded Claims" means a Party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations, its gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement or misappropriation of the other Party's intellectual property rights. The Company's obligations to pay amounts due under Section 3 shall not be treated as damages subject to the foregoing cap.

proposal.summary: Insert mutual liability cap with standard uncapped carve-outs

rationale: There is no limitation-of-liability, exclusion-of-damages or aggregate-liability language anywhere in the Agreement (Sections 1-10 reviewed in full), so both parties face unlimited direct and consequential exposure. We inserted a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000, a mutual consequential-damages exclusion, and uncapped Excluded Claims (confidentiality/data, indemnity, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement), with Company payment obligations excluded from the cap.
ruleTitle: Limitation of liability — cap, mutuality and carve-outs

ops.text: 4.3 Transition Assistance; Return of Data. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) at the Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance, including cooperation in migrating the Site to the Company or its designee, for up to six (6) months at HDI's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days, return to the Company all Content, customer, order and user data and other Company Confidential Information in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing.
